summary_1line: Sugriva impulsively attacks Ravana at Lanka’s gate, and the two kings engage in a brutal wrestling duel until Ravana turns to magic and Sugriva escapes skyward.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva leaps from Mount Suvela onto Lanka’s gate and snatches Ravana’s jeweled crown, hurling it to the ground.
Sugriva and Ravana grapple fiercely at the gateway, bloodied bodies locked together like battling lions among the trees.
As Ravana begins to use magic, Sugriva suddenly launches into the sky above Lanka while the exhausted demon king stands baffled below.
